prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Choose Your Companion Path", "Select Path"]
1: ["Sign In to Keep Your Pet Safe", "Connecting your account ensures your pet and settings are saved automatically.", "Sign In with Google"]
2: ["Customize Your Pet", "Select traits and preview your companion before adopting.", "Choose Traits"]
3: ["Setting Up Your Desktop Pet...", "Creating high-res desktop assets and preparing your pet.", "Generating assets"]
4: ["Welcome to Your Desktop Companion", "Your pet is now active on your screen."]
5: ["Save Your Companion Progress", "Sign in now so your desktop pet stays synced and protected against accidental resets.", "Restores your existing pet automatically."]
6: ["Sign Adoption Certificate", "Name your desktop pet and confirm adoption.", "Pet Name", "Official Adoption Seal"]
7: ["Preset path takes 1 min; photo creation takes ~3 mins."]
8: ["Your Desktop Companion is Ready!", "Click your pet on the desktop or press Alt+P to reveal options.", "Say Hello"]
9: ["Photo Upload Guidelines", "Follow these tips to ensure accurate pet generation.", "Clear face lighting and single subject"]
